header.file: Point Danger and Tweed River mouth, Tweed Heads IMGP1701.jpg
header.why: 3:2, 2010 colour: Tweed Heads shoreline and apartment towers across the river mouth under blue sky. Sibling of IMGP1702, already the Point Danger spot photo in region-nsw-northern-rivers, so a near-duplicate (reuse conflict risk); foreground is a dredged sandy bank.

4:3, 2020 colour: shallow beach lagoon with Norfolk pines and Coolangatta high-rises. The skyline is in Queensland (Coolangatta, the twin town across the border), so it represents the Tweed Heads and Coolangatta urban area, not the NSW side; judge on that.

header.file: Greenmount Beach, Rainbow Bay, Queensland pano.jpg
header.why: 2.02:1 (just outside 2.0 aspect), 2020 colour: same Coolangatta skyline and beach as above, wider; centre crop works but aspect is borderline.

why1.why: ~3:2, 2008 colour: Wollumbin reflected in Clarrie Hall Dam with lily pads and forested ridges, a valley view of the mountain, no summit climb. Licence CC BY-SA 3.0 per the sibling file; verify.

why1.file: Mt Warning as seen from Pinnacle Lookout in the NSW Border Ranges.jpg
why1.why: 2:1, 2023 colour: Wollumbin on the horizon over the Tweed Valley farmland and ridges from the Border Ranges. Mountain is small in frame; wide crop.

2.9:1 panorama from Mt Cougal's eastern peak: Mt Warning and the caldera rim centred, 2018 colour. Wide, so a 1.6:1 centre crop keeps Wollumbin in the middle; description confirms centred. Better caldera story than the others.

why1.file: Mt Warning in Wollumbin National Park.jpg
why1.why: 1.8:1, 2014 colour: layered ridges and distant ranges with blue sky and grass foreground; Wollumbin identity not obvious from the thumbnail, verify before use.

why2.why: 1.8:1, 2016 colour: the gallery building (grey and blue upper deck, glazed gallery) with trees and sky, landscape. Same photographer as 01 (which is already the spot photo), a different angle.

why2.file: Tweed River seen from Tweed Regional Gallery.jpeg
why2.why: 4:3, 2016 colour: the view from the gallery over farmland and the Tweed River toward the ranges. NOT the building, a weaker fit for the reason; fallback only. No other landscape exterior of the gallery or the Margaret Olley Art Centre exists on Commons (the category holds only these, a bronze statue and one portrait tiff).

why3.file: The start of the Northern Rivers Rail Trail at Murwillumbah railway station 01.jpg
why3.why: 4:3, 2026 colour: the sealed trail beside the old track at Murwillumbah station on a wet grey day; the trail itself but flat light, no rider. The Burringbar spot photo is already used elsewhere (spot list), so do not reuse that one if it is the spot photo of this region.

why3.file: The start of the Northern Rivers Rail Trail at Murwillumbah railway station 07.jpg
why3.why: 4:3, 2026 colour: trail start with old station building behind, overcast. Dull.
4:3, 2026 colour: trail head car park and shelter, bikes under the roof, trail signage. In the rail trail category.

why3.file: Burringbar, NSW Rail Trail stop April 2025.jpg
why3.why: ALREADY USED as a spot photo in region-nsw-northern-rivers skeptic.json (Burringbar rail trail stop); listed only because it is the best rail-trail photo with riders/bikes. 1.9:1, 2025 colour: Burringbar trail rest stop with bikes parked and a few people at the shelter; in the Northern Rivers Rail Trail category. People are incidental.
